content.text: 2026 Kentucky Derby and Kentucky Oaks Ticket Registration 152nd Kentucky Derby Ticket Information Experience the Kentucky Derby! Tickets for the 2026 Kentucky Derby and Kentucky Oaks are available for purchase now! You can call 502-636-4447 to discuss ticket options with one of our sales representatives at Churchill Downs Racetrack and tickets can be purchased directly over the phone. Or you can fill out one of the forms below to let us know what ticket packages you are interested in and one of our Sales Representatives will be in touch shortly! Most tickets for the Kentucky Derby and Kentucky Oaks are sold as a 2-day package which features all-inclusive food and beverage. To receive more information, email our Premium Sales team at myderby@kyderby.com, or give us a call any time at 502-636-4447. Ticket options include Reserved Seating areas, a limited number of Dining Rooms, and General Admission areas including traditional infield, Final Turn Upgrade, and Plaza Walkarounds, can be purchased online through Ticketmaster now! We look forward to hosting you for Kentucky Derby 152! Not Sure What You Are Looking For? Do you want to cross the Kentucky Derby off your bucket list but don't know how to get started? See what tickets are currently available for sale on Ticketmaster and Buy Now > Connect with one of our ticket representatives to help you have the ultimate Derby Day experience. Experience the thrills of the Run for the Roses® first hand to be a part of the excitement that will make memories that will last a lifetime. Reserved Seating For fans who want a guaranteed seat and a prime view of the action, Reserved Seating offers the perfect Derby Day experience. Explore our Reserved Seating options and find your ideal vantage point to take in every unforgettable moment at Churchill Downs. Luxury Dining & Premium Dining Indulge in the ultimate Kentucky Derby experience with Luxury Dining & Premium Dining—where world-class racing meets elevated hospitality. Explore our dining options to find the perfect culinary complement to your day at Churchill Downs. Private Suites Experience the Kentucky Derby in unmatched style and comfort with Private Suites at Churchill Downs. Explore our Private Suites offerings and make your Derby Day truly unforgettable. General Admission & Standing Room For fans looking to immerse themselves in the energy and excitement of Derby Day, General Admission & Standing Room tickets offer a vibrant, festival-style experience. Visit our Standing Room & General Admission page for tips and details to make the most of your day. TICKET BUYING OPTIONS There are plenty of ways to buy Kentucky Derby tickets! See some of best ways to purchase tickets below. PERSONAL SEAT LICENSE Reserve your Kentucky Derby and Oaks seats for multiple years! Kentucky Derby fans can buy a Personal Seat License (PSL) which allows them the right to purchase a specific seat location, in some of the most premiere areas of the facility, for the Kentucky Derby and Oaks, for up to 3 years. CORPORATE HOSPITALITY OPPORTUNITIES Celebrate the Kentucky Derby and Oaks in style with a private space for you and your guests. Our accommodations offer some of the finest amenities in all of professional sports – from breathtaking views of the races, to luxury furnishings and exclusive fine dining. Your guests will have an unforgettable experience in any of our venues. TURF CLUB MEMBERSHIP The Turf Club is an exclusive club at Churchill Downs Racetrack for members and their guests only, offering premium amenities including dining and excellent views of the racecourses here at our iconic venue. The Turf Club is located on the third floor of the clubhouse at the finish line. DERBY EXPERIENCES PACKAGES Derby Experiences is proud to be The Official Experience Package Provider to Churchill Downs® for the Kentucky Oaks® and the Kentucky Derby®. Derby Experiences provides guests with various all-inclusive Official Ticket Packages for an unmatched Kentucky Derby experience. HORSEMEN Participating owners of the Kentucky Derby and the Kentucky Oaks horse contenders receive 18 complimentary seats to the new, exclusive Winner’s Circle Suites, for the date in which their horse is running. The private Winner’s Circle Suites provide easy access to the trackside winner’s circle, racetrack, and Paddock, and offer full-service hospitality like premium open bar, in-suite catering, in-suite wagering stations. TICKETING AND ADMISSIONS POLICY View the Admission Policy for the 2024 Kentucky Derby at Churchill Downs. Have Questions? Learn more about the Kentucky Derby and get your questions answered through our helpful FAQs. Get event information to help you plan your trip to Churchill Downs on the first Saturday in May.
